This individual was a '''pirate''' in [[Kragan Gorr]]'s [[Warbird gang|pirate gang]]. This pirate participated in the [[Attack on the Colossus|attack]] on the independent refueling station known as the ''[[Colossus]]'', and uttered a high-pitching, whooping war cry as the Warbirds charged into battle.<ref name="The Triple Dark" />

During the raid, an ear-piercing disturbance was transmitted over the pirate's shared comm channel. While this pirate was stunned by it, their fighter was shot down and crashed into the [[ocean]].<ref name="The Triple Dark" />

The pirate wore [[stormtrooper armor]] and [[helmet]], customized with painted detailing, as well as the insignia of the Warbirds on the chest plate.<ref name="The Triple Dark" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Credited as ''Random Pirate'', this character first appeared in "[[The Triple Dark]]," the second episode of ''[[Star Wars Resistance]]'', and is voiced by [[Fred Tatasciore]].<ref name="The Triple Dark" />
